caption: with no Throw inside, Catch just returns the value
Catch(expr, tag) recovers a Throw with a matching tag
Throw exits the enclosing Catch, discarding the rest
Only the first throw is reached
A tag restricts which Catch receives the throw
The inner Catch handles the throw, the outer list continues
